add-rolling-updates-feature-flag-and-com.text: Keep TP nit. The test's subject is picocli option parsing: "Missing required argument" is a parse-time error raised before any run() executes. The PR's gate lives inside run() (UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java:45-49: isFeatureEnabled check -> printFeatureDisabled; picocli.exit(FEATURE_DISABLED); return), i.e. after parsing, and --file is declared optional at :39-41 with no required=true. So whether or not the gate fires, assertNoMessage("Missing required argument") at UpdateCommandDistTest.java:61 still verifies exactly what the test was written for: save accepts an omitted --file. The gate cannot mask the behaviour under test; it only means the test does not also check metadata generation, which it never claimed to. The PR changed only the @Launch args (:59), not the assertion; the gated path is positively verified by testFeatureNotEnabled (:46-50) and testCompatible (:73-74 Metadata: + exitCode 0). A stronger positive assertion is test tidying, not a test that fails to verify its behaviour.
